content:
olivia: ran into a weird behavior in the next-starter + LlamaIndex example during the onboarding workshop. batching + concurrent uploads cause duplicate embeddings and doubled token counts.

ben: can you share a repro?

olivia: simple: spawn 20 docs, use the sample batcher in the starter which calls SDK embeddings in parallel. sometimes the same doc gets embedded twice. here's the test harness I used:
```js
// simplified
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await Promise.all(docs.map(d => client.embeddings.create({ input: d.text })))
```

sam: is this the token-refresh race or a distinct concurrency dedupe problem?

aditya: could be both. if the SDK auto-retries on 401/429 and the starter batches/retries too, you get overlapped attempts. Do we pass idempotency keys anywhere in the starter?

olivia: no, starter is minimal. LlamaIndex connector also retries indexer steps on exception by default.

docs-bot: FYI I saw similar reports in the community channel last month when users ran the workshop under load.

ben: logs attached (excerpt):
```
2026-06-12T10:02:01.001Z INFO batcher starting batch size=20
2026-06-12T10:02:01.102Z WARN sdk token expiring
2026-06-12T10:02:01.103Z INFO sdk refresh ok
2026-06-12T10:02:01.104Z INFO sdk retrying request attempt=1
2026-06-12T10:02:01.105Z INFO app started embed for doc=doc-9
2026-06-12T10:02:01.106Z INFO app started embed for doc=doc-9 (duplicate)
2026-06-12T10:02:01.210Z ERROR backend embed status=429
```

sam: reproducible enough to add a tiny e2e. I can mock the backend and assert only one embed per doc id even when incoming calls are concurrent.

aditya: proposed short-term fixes: (1) Starter: add an in-memory coalesce util (dedupe by input hash) and call it from the batcher; (2) LlamaIndex sample: set step retry=0 and add instructions to pass idempotencyKey when indexing; (3) SDK: expose `x-redwood-idempotency` header and offer `REDWOOD_SDK_IDEMPOTENCY=auto` to generate keys per-input. Longer-term: server-side dedupe within a 5s window.

olivia: example coalesce util for the starter (very small):
```js
const inFlight = new Map()
function dedupePromise(key, fn) {
  if (inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key)
  const p = fn().finally(() => inFlight.delete(key))
  inFlight.set(key, p)
  return p
}
// usage
await Promise.all(docs.map(d => dedupePromise(d.id, () => client.embeddings.create({ input: d.text, idempotencyKey: d.id }))))
```

ben: that looks good for single-instance starters. edge/scale use-cases still need server-side dedupe.

aditya: plan: I'll land SDK flag to generate idempotency headers (opt-in) and add a small jitter on token-refresh retries to avoid tight replay storms. sam: if you add the mock e2e, we can gate this in CI.

sam: will add e2e with mocked embed service and an assertion that per-doc embed call count <=1. Also add a cost-smoke test to detect >1.2x token regression.

docs-bot: I'll update onboarding quickstart and the LlamaIndex connector example to show `idempotencyKey` usage and a note about disabling connector-level retries during indexing.

ci-bot: queued workflow/workshop-e2e -> will run after PRs.

olivia: thanks — I'll open PR for starter dedupe + docs change. tagging @aditya for SDK and @sam for tests.

aditya: will open SDK PR tomorrow and link to #server-dedupe. adding migration note to changelog.

ben: one more nit: prefer header name `x-redwood-idempotency` (matches infra)

aditya: agreed. using `x-redwood-idempotency`.

olivia: closing this thread once PRs land and workshop run passes. :thumbsup:
